guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 連結碎石樁置換率、側向拘束與排水證據判斷複合地盤。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Relate stone column replacement, lateral confinement and drainage evidence to composite ground. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設圓樁直徑D=0.8m、方格間距s=2m，a=πD²/(4s²)=0.1257，約12.6%；只適用完整方格單元。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設黏聚c=0、摩擦角φ=40°，理想三軸破壞比σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60；使用有效主應力。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設平均壓力q=100kPa、置換a=0.20、應力比n=σc/σs=4，σs=q/[1+a(n−1)]=62.5kPa，σc=250kPa。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設柱材k=0.01m/s、有效A=0.5m²、梯度i=0.2，Q=kiA=0.001m³/s；假設此流速下可採達西關係。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設D=0.8m、L=10m且等截面，V=πD²L/4=5.027m³，約5.03m³；此為成柱幾何體積，不是鬆散供料量。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設平均新增q=100kPa、改良層H=6m、有效拘束模數M=15000kPa，s=qH/M=0.040m；未含下層與次壓密。
factsEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For circular D=0.8m and square spacing s=2m, a=πD²/(4s²)=0.1257, about12.6%, for a complete square unit cell.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For c=0 and φ=40°, the ideal triaxial failure ratio σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60, using effective principal stresses.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For mean q=100kPa, a=0.20 and stress ratio n=σc/σs=4, σs=q/[1+a(n−1)]=62.5kPa and σc=250kPa.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For k=0.01m/s, effective A=0.5m² and i=0.2, Q=0.001m³/s, assuming Darcy behaviour at the relevant velocity.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For uniform D=0.8m and L=10m, V=πD²L/4=5.027m³, about5.03m³, representing geometric column volume rather than loose delivery.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For mean added q=100kPa, H=6m and effective constrained modulus M=15000kPa, s=qH/M=0.040m, excluding deeper layers and secondary compression.
timeline: 1985　美國聯邦公路管理局列出碎石樁設計施工手冊
2010　基督城南部高速公路開始碎石樁試驗
2017　地盤改良第一冊收錄粒料柱方法背景
timelineEn: 1985 — FHWA lists its stone-column design and construction manual
2010 — Christchurch Southern Motorway begins stone-column trials
2017 — Ground Modification Volume I includes aggregate-column methods
codes: 美國聯邦公路管理局碎石樁設計施工，1985
美國聯邦公路管理局GEC13地盤改良方法第一冊，2017
codesEn: FHWA Design and Construction of Stone Columns, 1985
FHWA GEC13 Ground Modification Methods Volume I, 2017
landmarks: 基督城南部高速公路：碎石樁試區
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出埋深或斷面、地質水文、支護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, ground and groundwater, support system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：振動碎石樁施工
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Vibro-replacement stone columns
guides.concept: 本課聚焦連結碎石樁置換率、側向拘束與排水證據判斷複合地盤。十個單元依序辨識作用機制、量化假設、驗證程序與故障徵兆，讓學徒追蹤從原始資料到工程判斷的每一環。每個算例都帶單位與限制，不把局部成功或單一比值當成完整系統合格。交接須保留基準、異常與權責工程師核准的條件。
guides.conceptEn: This course focuses on relate stone column replacement, lateral confinement and drainage evidence to composite ground. Ten units connect mechanisms, numerical assumptions, verification procedures and failure symptoms so apprentices can trace each inference from evidence to judgment. Every example includes units and limitations; one successful observation or ratio does not establish system acceptance. Handover retains datums, anomalies and conditions approved by the responsible engineer.
procedure: 碎石樁和原土共同承擔荷載，樁面積占單元面積的比例是配置起點。平均直徑不一定代表每一深度的有效斷面，網格邊界與漏樁也會改變實際置換。假設圓樁直徑D=0.8m、方格間距s=2m，a=πD²/(4s²)=0.1257，約12.6%；只適用完整方格單元。若將三角網格與方格公式混用，置換率會被誤算；實際縮頸或場界缺柱也可使名義比例失去代表性，集中載重下會增加差異沉陷。
碎石柱不是可獨立受壓的鋼筋混凝土樁，粒料抗剪需要周圍土體提供拘束。理想摩擦材料的主應力比顯示拘束重要性，但不能直接當整根柱的承載公式。假設黏聚c=0、摩擦角φ=40°，理想三軸破壞比σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60；使用有效主應力。上部極軟土不能提供足夠側壓時，柱體可能向外鼓脹；只驗石料本身強度會忽略複合地盤的控制機制，使樁頭沉陷超出設計預期。
複合地盤中較硬柱體常吸引較多應力，但分配受剛度、變形相容及載重面積影響。等應變單元可說明平衡，應力集中比必須有分析或試驗依據。假設平均壓力q=100kPa、置換a=0.20、應力比n=σc/σs=4，σs=q/[1+a(n−1)]=62.5kPa，σc=250kPa。把柱體應力直接等於平均地壓會低估局部需求；反之若假設全部荷載都由柱承擔，會錯估原土變形與長期排水，引致不合理的容量判斷。
高透水柱體可提供排水路徑，但是否有效取決於連通、濾層及周圍土進水能力。達西通量只描述選定柱段，不能以柱材高透水性證明全地盤迅速消散孔壓。假設柱材k=0.01m/s、有效A=0.5m²、梯度i=0.2，Q=kiA=0.001m³/s；假設此流速下可採達西關係。細土遷移可堵塞柱周界而讓柱芯仍保持高透水，實際進水卻受限；排水出口封閉時，柱體也可能只重新分配水壓而無法排出地盤。
理想圓柱體積有助核對材料帳，但實際投入量含鬆散堆積、地盤擴張及施工損失。材料超量或不足均需解釋，不能直接把卡車運送體積當竣工直徑證明。假設D=0.8m、L=10m且等截面，V=πD²L/4=5.027m³，約5.03m³；此為成柱幾何體積，不是鬆散供料量。單靠總用量可漏掉上部過度擴張而下部縮頸的柱體；整根帳面體積吻合時，深部薄弱斷面仍可能控制鼓脹或沉陷，無法由平均量排除。
改良後沉陷取決於有效複合模數與未改善下層，簡化一維估算只適用指定應力範圍。柱土分配模型和模數選定需相容，不能把石料模數直接當整片地盤模數。假設平均新增q=100kPa、改良層H=6m、有效拘束模數M=15000kPa，s=qH/M=0.040m；未含下層與次壓密。若主要軟層延伸到柱底以下，表層改善仍不能消除整體沉陷；將柱材高模數套用全深度，會使估算過小並誤判鄰接構造的差異位移。
排水能否跟上載重歷程需要比較時間尺度，不只比較滲透係數大小。擴散估算用於提出問題，實際徑向幾何、塗抹區及非線性都可能改變消散時間。假設特徵路徑L=1m、擴散係數c=0.05m²/s，t≈L²/c=20s；只是量級，不證明地震期間已充分排水。若把慢速試驗的排水改善直接套到短暫地震，孔壓可能來不及消散；高透水材料存在不代表土中水能及時進入柱體，排水效益會被高估。
柱端荷載和側向傳遞共同決定底部應力，不能假設所有荷載都傳至硬層。端面平均壓力只是一個局部需求量，若柱端坐落軟土，需考慮刺入及下部壓縮。假設抵達柱端P=300kN、D=0.8m，qt=P/(πD²/4)=596.8kPa，約597kPa；P不是整根柱頂載重的必然值。薄硬層下仍有軟土時可發生穿刺與整體下沉，柱端壓力再低也不代表安全；錯把短暫施工阻力當成持力層，會使終孔深度缺乏根據。
邊緣柱的拘束、荷載分配及排水邊界和內柱不同，不應一律用單元對稱模型。試驗結果比較要說明位置及載重範圍，避免把邊界效應誤認為施工品質差。假設可比較沉陷下邊柱載重Pedge=240kN、內柱Pinner=300kN，比值=0.80；這是試驗比較，不是通用邊柱折減係數。邊柱外側缺乏拘束可能先鼓脹，若只驗中央柱便會漏掉控制位置；外圍施工障礙又可降低置換率，兩種效應疊加會增加基礎角落沉陷。
長期排水維護決定柱體作為水力通路是否仍有效，出口淤塞可使水頭回升。孔壓增量應和荷載及有效應力一起評估，不能把碎石存在視為永遠暢通。假設局部排水水頭增加Δh=2m，Δu=γwΔh=9.81×2=19.62kPa，約19.6kPa；未改變總應力時有效應力同量下降。若排水失效後仍沿用施工期的有效應力與模數，可能高估服務能力；長期水位回升與附加載重一起出現時，沉陷或局部鼓脹會加速發展。
procedureEn: Stone columns and native soil share load, making area replacement a starting descriptor. Mean diameter does not establish effective section at every depth, while boundaries and missing columns alter actual replacement. For circular D=0.8m and square spacing s=2m, a=πD²/(4s²)=0.1257, about12.6%, for a complete square unit cell. Confusing triangular and square grids miscalculates replacement. Necking or missing boundary columns can also invalidate nominal coverage and increase differential settlement beneath localized concentrated loads.

A stone column is not an independently supported reinforced-concrete pile. Aggregate shear resistance needs surrounding confinement; an ideal frictional stress ratio illustrates that dependence rather than providing a whole-column capacity formula. For c=0 and φ=40°, the ideal triaxial failure ratio σ1′/σ3′=(1+sinφ)/(1−sinφ)=4.60, using effective principal stresses. Very soft upper soil may not provide adequate lateral restraint, allowing bulging. Testing aggregate strength alone misses the composite-ground mechanism and can leave column-head settlement larger than anticipated.

Stiffer columns often attract more stress, with sharing governed by stiffness, compatibility and loaded area. An equal-strain cell illustrates equilibrium, but its concentration ratio requires analytical or experimental support. For mean q=100kPa, a=0.20 and stress ratio n=σc/σs=4, σs=q/[1+a(n−1)]=62.5kPa and σc=250kPa. Equating column stress with mean pressure understates local demand. Assuming columns take everything instead misrepresents native-soil deformation and drainage, leading to an unreliable judgment of capacity.

A permeable column provides drainage only with connectivity, filtering and inflow from the surrounding soil. Darcy flow describes a selected segment; high aggregate permeability alone does not prove rapid pressure dissipation throughout the ground. For k=0.01m/s, effective A=0.5m² and i=0.2, Q=0.001m³/s, assuming Darcy behaviour at the relevant velocity. Fine migration can clog the perimeter while the core remains permeable, limiting inflow. With a closed outlet, the column may merely redistribute pressure rather than discharge water from the ground.

Ideal cylindrical volume helps reconcile material, but delivered quantities include loose packing, ground expansion and losses. Both excess and shortage need explanation; truck volume alone does not demonstrate as-built diameter. For uniform D=0.8m and L=10m, V=πD²L/4=5.027m³, about5.03m³, representing geometric column volume rather than loose delivery. Total quantity can hide an oversized upper segment and a necked lower one. Even a matching volume balance cannot exclude a weak deep section controlling bulging or settlement.

Settlement depends on composite stiffness and untreated deeper layers. A one-dimensional estimate applies within a specified stress range; load sharing and modulus must agree, rather than substituting aggregate modulus for the entire ground. For mean added q=100kPa, H=6m and effective constrained modulus M=15000kPa, s=qH/M=0.040m, excluding deeper layers and secondary compression. Soft soil below column toes can continue dominating settlement despite surface improvement. Extending aggregate stiffness through the full profile produces an unrealistically small estimate and misjudges differential movement.

Whether drainage keeps pace with loading requires comparing timescales, not permeability alone. A diffusion estimate frames the question; radial geometry, smear and nonlinearity can substantially change dissipation. For characteristic L=1m and diffusion coefficient c=0.05m²/s, t≈L²/c=20s. This scale does not establish adequate drainage during an earthquake. Transferring drainage benefits from a slow test to a brief earthquake can overstate dissipation. Permeable aggregate does not ensure pore water can enter the column quickly enough during shaking.

Toe load and side transfer govern base stress; not all load automatically reaches a hard stratum. Mean toe pressure is a local demand, and a toe in soft soil requires checks for punching and underlying compression. For toe load P=300kN and D=0.8m, qt=P/(πD²/4)=596.8kPa, about597kPa. Toe load need not equal the column-head load. A thin hard lens over soft soil can punch through and settle as a system. Misreading temporary installation resistance as a bearing layer leaves the chosen termination depth unsupported.

Edge columns differ in confinement, load sharing and drainage from interior columns, limiting symmetric-cell assumptions. Comparisons need position and loading extent so boundary effects are not automatically labelled poor workmanship. At comparable settlement, hypothetical edge load240kN and interior load300kN give a ratio0.80. This is a test comparison, not a universal edge reduction factor. An edge column can bulge first where restraint is missing. Testing only the centre misses that condition, while perimeter obstructions reduce replacement and compound settlement near foundation corners.

Long-term outlet maintenance determines whether columns remain effective hydraulic paths. Blockage can raise head, and the resulting pressure change must be assessed with loading and effective stress rather than assuming permanent drainage. For a local head increase Δh=2m, Δu=9.81×2=19.62kPa, about19.6kPa. Effective stress falls by the same amount if total stress is unchanged. Retaining construction-stage effective stress and stiffness after drainage loss overestimates service performance. Water-level recovery combined with added load can accelerate settlement or local column bulging.
evidence: 交接方格置換面積時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。用竣工坐標與材料記錄核對每個單元，檢查不同深度的可能縮頸。圖面列出場界、障礙及漏樁位置，不能以全場平均替代關鍵基礎下的局部配置。
交接粒料側向拘束時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。對照粒料級配與剪切試驗，評估周圍軟土強度及可能鼓脹區。載重試驗須追蹤沉陷和側向變形，由設計工程師確認是否需要包覆或其他拘束措施。
交接等應變荷載分配時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。以柱頂及土面荷重資料核對單元力平衡，觀察沉陷是否足以支持等應變假設。若柱土分離、局部荷重或墊層拱效應明顯，應重建分配模型。
交接柱體排水通量時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。檢查粒料與周圍土的濾層相容性，並量測柱內外孔壓的時間差。核對上部排水出口是否暢通，不能只以供料場的滲透試驗替代整個排水系統驗證。
交接成柱材料體積時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。以分深度施工紀錄、投入量與材料體積換算核對成柱連續性，異常區配合適用檢測。保存實際深度與平台高程，避免起算面不同導致長度差被誤認成超耗。
evidenceEn: When handing over square grid replacement area, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Reconcile as-built coordinates and material records by cell, checking possible necking with depth. Mark boundaries, obstructions and missing columns instead of substituting a site average for local foundation coverage.

When handing over aggregate lateral confinement, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Review gradation and shear tests together with native-soil strength and potential bulging zones. Monitor settlement and lateral deformation in load tests so the designer can assess additional confinement or encasement.

When handing over equal strain load sharing, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Check cell equilibrium using column and soil loading evidence and assess whether measured movement supports equal strain. Separation, localized loading or significant mat arching requires a revised sharing model.

When handing over column drainage flow, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Check filter compatibility with native soil and measure pressure lag inside and outside columns. Verify outlet continuity rather than using quarry permeability tests as acceptance of the complete drainage system.

When handing over column material volume, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Reconcile depth records, quantities and volume conversions to assess continuity, investigating anomalies with suitable tests. Preserve depth and platform datum so different starting elevations are not mistaken for excessive consumption.
pitfalls: 若將三角網格與方格公式混用，置換率會被誤算；實際縮頸或場界缺柱也可使名義比例失去代表性，集中載重下會增加差異沉陷。
把柱體應力直接等於平均地壓會低估局部需求；反之若假設全部荷載都由柱承擔，會錯估原土變形與長期排水，引致不合理的容量判斷。
單靠總用量可漏掉上部過度擴張而下部縮頸的柱體；整根帳面體積吻合時，深部薄弱斷面仍可能控制鼓脹或沉陷，無法由平均量排除。
若把慢速試驗的排水改善直接套到短暫地震，孔壓可能來不及消散；高透水材料存在不代表土中水能及時進入柱體，排水效益會被高估。
邊柱外側缺乏拘束可能先鼓脹，若只驗中央柱便會漏掉控制位置；外圍施工障礙又可降低置換率，兩種效應疊加會增加基礎角落沉陷。
pitfallsEn: Confusing triangular and square grids miscalculates replacement. Necking or missing boundary columns can also invalidate nominal coverage and increase differential settlement beneath localized concentrated loads.

Equating column stress with mean pressure understates local demand. Assuming columns take everything instead misrepresents native-soil deformation and drainage, leading to an unreliable judgment of capacity.
Total quantity can hide an oversized upper segment and a necked lower one. Even a matching volume balance cannot exclude a weak deep section controlling bulging or settlement.
Transferring drainage benefits from a slow test to a brief earthquake can overstate dissipation. Permeable aggregate does not ensure pore water can enter the column quickly enough during shaking.

An edge column can bulge first where restraint is missing. Testing only the centre misses that condition, while perimeter obstructions reduce replacement and compound settlement near foundation corners.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

related.title: 動力夯實地盤改良
related.transfer: 可遷移「方格置換面積」與「排水時間尺度」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；動力夯實地盤改良的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Square grid replacement area" and "Drainage time scale" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Dynamic compaction of ground must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦連結碎石樁置換率、側向拘束與排水證據判斷複合地盤；動力夯實地盤改良則以以能量、孔壓與鄰近振動證據評估動力夯實成效為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on relate stone column replacement, lateral confinement and drainage evidence to composite ground; Dynamic compaction of ground centres on evaluate dynamic compaction through energy, pore pressure and neighbouring vibration evidence, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「方格置換面積」與「落錘位能尺度」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到動力夯實地盤改良，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「乾密度與含水」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Square grid replacement area” and “Drop weight energy scale”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Dynamic compaction of ground, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Dry density and moisture", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 振動碎石樁施工
history.text: 本課以公開工程研究與機構文件建立連結碎石樁置換率、側向拘束與排水證據判斷複合地盤的背景。美國聯邦公路管理局列出碎石樁設計施工手冊（1985）。基督城南部高速公路開始碎石樁試驗（2010）。地盤改良第一冊收錄粒料柱方法背景（2017）。兩個地標用來比較環境、量測與維護證據，並非宣稱本課每一教學構件都實際用於兩處。來源若只可讀摘要，適用範圍已另行註明；現場設計須重新確認規範版本與責任。本課只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: This course uses public research and institutional documents to establish context for relate stone column replacement, lateral confinement and drainage evidence to composite ground. FHWA lists its stone-column design and construction manual (1985). Christchurch Southern Motorway begins stone-column trials (2010). Ground Modification Volume I includes aggregate-column methods (2017). The two landmarks compare environments, measurements and maintenance evidence; they do not imply that every teaching component was installed at both sites. Abstract-only access is declared in source scopes. Field design requires current applicability and responsible review. This course reconstructs public principles only.
